culture-sciences.prompt: Name a field of science ending in “ology”.
culture-sciences.note: Use a recognized science or scientific specialty whose English name ends in the letters ology. Standard spelling variants qualify; nonscientific beliefs do not.

culture-greek-deities.prompt: Name a deity from Greek mythology.
culture-greek-deities.note: Established gods, goddesses, Titans, and divine personifications from Greek mythology qualify. Solely Roman figures and solely mortal heroes do not qualify.

culture-palindromes.prompt: Name a single English word that is a palindrome.
culture-palindromes.note: Use a single English word whose letters read identically forward and backward. Ignore capitalization; multiword phrases do not qualify. Standard inflected or derived words count if they remain palindromes.

culture-silent-initials.prompt: Name an English word with a silent first letter.
culture-silent-initials.note: Use an English dictionary word whose first written letter is unpronounced in a standard English pronunciation. Standard regional pronunciations may differ; inflected and derived words qualify if the first letter remains silent.

culture-double-o.note: Use a single English dictionary word containing adjacent letters oo. Standard inflected and derived words qualify when they retain those adjacent letters.

culture-qu-words.prompt: Name an English word beginning with “qu”.
culture-qu-words.note: Use a single English dictionary word starting with the letters qu. Standard inflected and derived words qualify when they still start with qu.

culture-z-words.prompt: Name an English word beginning with “z”.
culture-z-words.note: Use a single English dictionary word starting with z. Proper names do not qualify; standard inflected and derived words count when they still start with z.

culture-ph-words.note: Use a single English dictionary word containing adjacent letters ph anywhere. Proper names do not qualify; standard inflected and derived words count when they retain ph.

culture-less-words.prompt: Name an English word ending in “less”.
culture-less-words.note: Use a single English dictionary word ending with the letters less. Standard inflected and derived words count only when the complete word still ends in less.

culture-double-e.note: Use a single English dictionary word containing adjacent letters ee. Proper names do not qualify; standard inflected and derived words count when they retain those adjacent letters.

culture-five-letter-animals.prompt: Name an animal whose English name has five letters.
culture-five-letter-animals.note: Use a single English common animal name with exactly five letters. Singular names only; species names and broader animal-group names both qualify.

words-ending-ness.prompt: Name an English word ending in ness.
words-ending-ness.note: A single dictionary word ending with the exact letters ness. Standard word forms and inflections count when they satisfy the literal ending.

words-ending-ing.prompt: Name an English word ending in ing.
words-ending-ing.note: A single dictionary word ending with the exact letters ing. Standard word forms and inflections count when they satisfy the literal ending.

words-ending-tion.prompt: Name an English word ending in tion.
words-ending-tion.note: A single dictionary word ending with the exact letters tion. Standard word forms and inflections count when they satisfy the literal ending.
